objective: Agent-facing AutoLab for the ECC2K-130 Crossbred α thread. Replay frozen X1/X3, refuse an α claim without ≥4 usable rungs, and run the next open beat (chained m=4 FFD).
claim_hygiene: Public synthetic Koblitz toys only. Q_enum undercounts enumeration. Wall-clock is a footnote. GPU/SAT/table cannot be reported as α. A two-point sketch is not a fit.

boundaries.unit_x1_x3: 64-bit word XOR; Q_enum = C(|F|, m-1) at one word-op per pair
boundaries.success: OLS slope of log2(Q/Q_enum) vs ell ≤ -0.5 (α ≤ 1.5) over ≥4 agreeing m=3 rungs with |F| ≥ 3 in one frame
boundaries.falsifier: slope ≥ -0.1 (α ≥ 1.9), or fewer than four usable rungs
boundaries.selection: T4: smallest D then smallest k with kernel_dim ≥ v-k, v-k in 1..=64, solve_crossbred on probe not exhausted, k < min(v, 22)

frozen.x1_verdict: no fit; two usable chained rungs
frozen.x3_verdict: no fit; two usable K_1 rungs

smoke.x1_n5.label: Replay chained K_0 n=5 m=3 under T4
smoke.x1_n5.note: Confirms the bench and T4 still produce the frozen X1 cell. Not a new α.

replay.x3_k1_n7.label: Replay symmetrised K_1 n=7 m=3 under T4

fit.alpha.label: Assemble usable rungs and attempt the α OLS fit
fit.alpha.note: OLS per frame on frozen X1 and X3. Mixing frames is inadmissible. A fit requires four usable rungs in one frame.

x5.ffd_chained_m4.label: X5 smoke: chained-x FFD at m=3 and m=4, n=9 and n=15, 4 draws, d_max=3

expect.falsifier: FFD max grows with n at m=4
expect.incumbent: RESEARCH_KOBLITZ_SCALING_TARGET.md: FFD max=3 on chained m≥3

x5.ffd_chained_m4.note: This is the chained x-system, not the missing symmetrised chain. A growing FFD here would still be a result. Four draws is a smoke; promotion needs 16.
